decisions.reason: Collecting and routing TicketsAwarded logs is an ingestion mechanism; it does not change the required ticket totals, surfaces, backfill policy, or accounting rules.
Including Mint logs in the webhook does not change when success feedback appears, which token ID it displays, or the required referral-specific modal wording.
The event-ingestion configuration does not change commission-count rules or the requirement to represent commissions consistently across product surfaces.
The backend webhook configuration does not entail any change to customer-facing FAQ content.
Routing contract events does not change the trigger, recipient-selection rule, ticket count, first-mint exception, or finalization semantics for no-referral tickets.
Although ingested events may support backend processing, the source does not change which NFT metadata attributes must be shown or their required accuracy.
The webhook's event coverage does not change the amount, trigger, recipient, first-mint exception, or finalization rule for no-referral commissions.
Mentioning ReferralUsed and TicketsAwarded as routed events does not alter the ticket issuance trigger, recipient, quantity, or draw-cycle rules.
The contract-log ingestion configuration does not require any change to the About page's text or presentation.
Event routing does not change the code-used commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or earning limits.
The source concerns contract-event collection and does not alter which NFT entitlements, referral identity, badges, or ticket state transfer on resale.
Collecting all contract logs does not modify the Small Block prize amount, winner count, draw trigger, ticket window, reset behavior, or funding rules.
